title: Single hieratic sign, Paris, Musée du Louvre, E 25416 (AKU HT 62493)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Kyra van der Moezel; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 62493

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 62493; AKU grapheme D0770 (AKU GR 169). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: D54 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 119, 120. Source publication of this facsimile: Posener-Kriéger und Cenival 1968, pl. 14A. Occurrence: line 5; find place Abusir; writing direction "Kolumnen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 6.5 x 5.9 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Altes Reich, 5. Dynastie, Djedkare". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Kyra van der Moezel. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
